item.title: Distinguished Gentleman’s Ride raises over $6k in Salida
item.description: This year’s Distinguished Gentleman’s Ride, a national event raising awareness for men's mental health and prostate cancer via a vintage motorcycle ride, raised more than $6,000 in Salida May 17.

item.title: Takacs named acting director of DHS
item.description: Meredith Takacs is serving as the interim director for Chaffee County Department of Human Services. Takacs has been serving in the position for about a month, following former Director Monica Haskell’s departure.
item.dc:creator: By Guinnevere Stropes, Mail Staff Writer

item.title: Council affirms R2 zoning, question to be sent to ballot
item.description: Salida City Council affirmed its decision to keep the 5H LLC property zoned as R2 and agreed to a special election on whether that property should remain zoned R2 during a regular meeting May 19.
item.dc:creator: By Guinnevere Stropes, Mail Staff Writer

item.title: Artspace steps back from First and D: City goes ‘back to drawing board’

item.title: Cotopaxi sends three to state track, Eggleston takes gold
item.description: Three Cotopaxi High School track and field athletes competed in the 1A State Track and Field Championships May 14-16 in Lakewood. They placed ninth as a team, and one runner brought home a state championship.
